comparison.objective: Place two setting blocks and stand a glass unit on them inside a frame without touching the sill.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual fragile-panel handling, narrow-channel alignment, controlled lowering, and support placement.
comparison.success_condition: Both blocks and the released glass must meet pose, support, centering, stillness, and clearance limits; any sill touch is an irreversible failure.
comparison.reason: Fragile large-panel glazing tests support preparation and collision-free lowering, not fine latch release or wire-mediated extraction.
